question: What vow did Jephthah make to the LORD before fighting the Ammonites?
options: Whatever came out of his door to meet him when he returned would be the LORD's, as a burnt offering
He would build a temple for the LORD
He would give a tenth of the plunder
He would never cut his hair
explanation: Jephthah vowed that if the LORD gave him victory, whatever came out of the door of his house to meet him would be the LORD's, and he would offer it as a burnt offering.
